exposure: Placental Growth Factor (PlGF) measurement (revealed vs concealed)
PlGF concentration: i) very low (<12 pg/ml), ii) low (12-100 pg/ml), iii) normal (>100 pg/ml)
cohort: 396 women with suspected pre-eclampsia or fetal growth restriction <35 weeks' gestation with revealed PlGF measurement
finding: Revealed PlGF use was associated with earlier delivery, lower perinatal mortality and birthweight <3rd centile, but more neonatal respiratory morbidity.
